payload.title: File:Simonettoia tilaventina (holotype, neck and trunk).png
payload.artist_html: S. Renesto, F. Saller, F. M. Dalla Vecchia
payload.credit_html: "'Simonettoia tilaventina, a new tanystropheid (Diapsida Archosauromorpha) from the Upper Triassic (Norian) of northeastern Italy"
payload.description_html: Simonettoia tilaventina, holotype, the hyperelongated cervical vertebra. A) The element in the counterslab, with the extremities indicated by the arrows; B) the element in the main slab with the left femur for comparison. Abbreviations: cr8-9, the "plowshare-like" ribs of the cervicals 8-9; cv3-9, cervical vertebrae 3-9; cdv, caudal vertebrae; fe, femur; lb, ‘lumbar’ rib; lv1-3, ‘lumbar’ vertebrae 1-3.
